description: The Weekly Pulse for one week, as JSON: what changed at The Mine (new periods, agencies' revisions, first values, values entered by hand, late and paused sources, the next checks), in fixed sentences built only from stored figures; no model writes it. Default: the latest issue. Optional detail: summary (default) or full. Figures are public statistics exactly as the agencies published them, with each one's period, retrieval date and source. Each result has a coverage line that says exactly what the figure covers (for example, I-94 arrivals are U.S.-wide by country of residence, not arrivals to Hawaiʻi). Each result carries the notice its source requires, and our Terms ask that it stay with the figure. Facts, not investment or other advice.

date.description: The issue's Monday, YYYY-MM-DD (Honolulu time); default the latest

detail.description: summary (default): counts, fixed sentences and each change's series, period, value and source; full: the whole stored issue

name: weekly_pulse
title: The Weekly Pulse
